article: Select or Clear All Enabled Checkboxes on a Web Page
scope: Compared the full Japanese source and twelve translations, selection behavior, disabled controls, click/change event semantics, bookmarklet creation instructions, safety note, metadata, and links.
findings: Removed duplicate future date and retained the original 2022-10-05 date; set lastmod to 2026-11-24.
Fixed the original script so it activates checkboxes with click behavior instead of assigning `.checked` without notifying page handlers.
Added a matching clear-all script and bookmarklet; both skip disabled controls and affect only the current document.
Removed an unrelated internal link to a C-language article.
Added a caution about trusted pages and possible page reactions before submitting or saving changes.
